title.narrative: Global Youth Grant Scheme - Powering up MIL responses to discrimination

description.narrative: With 75% of young people accessing internet today, this generation of youth is not only consuming internet and social media. Considered as “digital natives”, young people today are at the forefront of adopting new technologies developing content and shaping digital trends globally. In this context, Media and Information Literacy (MIL) is a critical tool that youth can apply to fight discrimination and address risks and challenges related to the dissemination of hate speech and racist content. Through a Global Youth Grant Scheme, UNESCO will invest in youth-led solutions that empower youth to apply MIL to fight discrimination.
